ideas.pitch: A zero-knowledge proof credential verification portal that allows students to prove enrollment or exam eligibility without revealing personal identifying data or grades.
ideas.title: ZK-Gated Student Credential Verification
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages zero-knowledge cryptography which is a proven winning pattern at technical hackathons, fitting directly into the Cybersecurity and Web3 tracks.

ideas.pitch: A Web3 platform utilizing stealth addresses for private, recurring micro-donations and scholarship distributions to deserving students across national institutions.
ideas.title: Decentralized Micro-Scholarship Streaming
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the FinTech and Web3 tracks by solving a real-world educational funding transparency problem using privacy-preserving blockchain architecture.

ideas.pitch: A secure collaboration workspace leveraging multi-party computation principles to allow researchers to train and share insights on sensitive medical or educational datasets without exposing raw data.
ideas.title: Secure Multiparty AI Research Collaboration
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hard engineering in distributed systems with the Healthcare and AI/ML tracks, appealing to judges looking for deep technical execution.

ideas.pitch: An educational credential layer-2 rollapp ensuring tamper-proof issuance and instantaneous verification of university degrees and certifications.
ideas.title: RollApp-Powered Academic Credential Ledger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates advanced decentralized architecture within the EdTech and Open Innovation tracks by implementing a dedicated rollapp solution.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent framework designed to cross-reference academic research claims against decentralized fact-checking and cryptographic proof stores.
ideas.title: AI Agent Fact-Checking Oracle for Research
ideas.why_it_could_win: Merges trending AI agent workflows with hard-verification mechanics, directly hitting both the AI/ML and Open Innovation tracks.
